quality_gates: latest goal is explicit and newer than invalidated goals
each completed action has command, exit code, artifact, or source URL evidence
multi-issue sessions have per-issue mini summaries
known bad facts and failed attempts are isolated from the active plan
raw evidence path exists or source URL is recorded
fallback condition names when to reread original context
poisoning_controls: do not carry superseded plans as active instructions
mark failed assumptions as excluded unless intentionally retried
prefer exact paths, ids, and command outputs over natural-language memory

quality_gates: Responses API migration stays pilot-only until local runner exists
manual replay preserves assistant item phase values
structured output schema lives in API config rather than prompt prose
stable prompt prefix precedes dynamic task context
store=false or encrypted reasoning policy is explicit when retention constraints apply
poisoning_controls: do not merge tool outputs into free-form summaries without call ids
do not replay stale assistant items after rollback without a rollback marker
